short_description: Private, fully customizable Key West boat charter for sandbars, snorkeling, dolphins, sunset, casual family fishing, and special occasions.
cancellation_summary: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before departure for a refund
location_address: 7001 Shrimp Rd Dock A Slip #32 Stock Island, FL US 33040
description:
The most flexible charter Six Fins offers. Combine sandbars, snorkeling, dolphin watching, sightseeing, sunset, and other activities in one private day. Casual fishing may be included as one part of the itinerary and is best for children, beginners, and families who simply want to wet a line. It does not provide the preparation, fishing time, effort, or focus of a dedicated fishing charter. If you want a true Key West fishing experience, reserve our Private Patch Reef Fishing charter. Your USCG-licensed captain builds the route around your priorities and current conditions aboard the 30' Jeanneau yacht. Group-only — no shared boat.

Quick facts:
• 6 hrs $1,395
• 8 hrs $1,795
• 10 hrs $2,195
• Private
• USCG-licensed captain
• Perry Hotel & Marina
• Fuel + safety gear included

what_is_included_items.value: Large lily pad (upon request at the dock)
Fishing gear for casual, family-friendly fishing (request in advance; conditions permitting)
Stand-up paddleboard (upon request at the dock)
Two bean bag chairs (upon request at the dock)

what_is_not_included_items.value: Tipping the captain and crew (gratuity not included; typical minimum 20%)

itinerary:
1. Meet at The Perry Hotel & Marina, Dock A, Slip #32; brief safety overview and flexible departure time.
2. Dolphin search and scenic harbor cruise with local commentary.
3. Snorkeling over reefs or backcountry patch reefs; snorkel gear provided.
4. Sandbar stop for swimming, floating, and relaxing.
5. Optional activities may include casual fishing for children and beginners when arranged in advance and conditions permit, a sunset extension, backwater eco tour, or harbor restaurant stop; return cruise to the marina.
highlights:
* Fully customizable private charter tailored to your group
* Experienced local captains with local knowledge
* Dolphin watching in natural habitat
* Snorkeling vibrant reefs and clear backcountry waters
* Sandbar stops ideal for celebrations and relaxation
* Flexible start times to fit your schedule
highlight_description:
- Luxury Boat
- 5-star Reviews
- Great Local Captain's
- Complimentary use of the Hotel & Marina Pools and Gym
check_in_details: Free parking is available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina. The boat is located on Dock A, Slip #32. Arrive 15 minutes before departure.
special_requirements: Parents or guardians of infants and toddlers must supply their own USCG-approved lifejacket (PFD).
extras: Fuel surcharge for groups over six passengers at $35 per hour; live bait and chum available.
disclaimers: All itineraries are subject to weather, sea conditions, U.S. Coast Guard advisories, and captain discretion; routes and activities may be adjusted for safety. Wildlife sightings are common but not guaranteed. Snorkeling, sandbar stops, casual fishing, and sunset timing depend on tides, wind, visibility, and seasonal conditions. Guests must arrive on time; late arrivals may reduce charter time without refund. Excessive intoxication, unsafe behavior, or failure to follow captain instructions may result in early termination without refund. Six Fins is not responsible for personal items lost, stolen, or damaged during the charter.
